prompts.universal_aura_generator: Create a Minecraft Mekanism AURA GENERATOR texture sheet using the attached image as the STRICT style reference. The reference contains actual Mekanism 16x16 machine textures enlarged with nearest-neighbor. MATCH their very low resolution, coarse square pixels, restrained gray palette, flat industrial simplicity, and dark recessed machine openings. Do not make a fantasy illustration, ornament, jewel, shiny metal painting, wood, stone altar, or detailed sci-fi concept art. The new sheet must have an exact equal 2x2 grid, no labels, no gaps. Each quadrant must look like ONLY 16x16 SOLID COLORED PIXEL CELLS enlarged; do not add detail smaller than these large cells. At least 85 percent of each face is neutral charcoal/dark gray/mid gray/light gray, only 4-8 grayscale values. Tiny muted green accents only. TOP LEFT: new idle front face, a dark square machine recess, small narrow vertical green energy gauge in its center, blocky gray electrical contacts at the sides; frame and panel thickness like original Mekanism, not thick decorative borders. TOP RIGHT: new plain gray top face, recessed square access panel with a small dark vent and two subtle green pixels. BOTTOM LEFT: new plain side/back/bottom face, gray industrial panel with a simple black 6-pixel-wide horizontal vent, a few coarse gray surface pixels, no colored ornament. BOTTOM RIGHT: the same front geometry as top left, active state with only the few gauge pixels brighter lime green. Every boundary lies on the same coarse 16x16 logical pixel grid. No bevel rendered with dozens of tiny steps, no copper coils, no crystals, no round glowing cores, no starbursts, no bloom, no gradient, no texture noise, no lettering. These are flat game texture images, not blocks rendered in 3D. Output opaque PNG.

Reference image 2 is our new aura generator texture family/layout. Exact equal 2x2 grid, no margins, no labels, no gutters. Each quadrant must be ONLY 16x16 SOLID COLOR PIXEL CELLS enlarged. At least 85% neutral gray/charcoal, palette and pixel sizes like both references. No detail smaller than one of those big pixels. Top left=idle front, top right=top panel, bottom left=side/back/bottom panel, bottom right=active front, with the same case and geometry as idle and only a few brighter indicator pixels. NO fantasy ornament, wood, marble, bronze borders, crystals, jewels, ornate runes, gradient, bloom, small pixel noise, typography, perspective or rendered cube. Flat opaque game textures. Device: UNIVERSAL FOREST RITUAL MACHINE. Front has a small simplified 3-5 pixel green sapling symbol in a recessed machine chamber, with a tiny brown stem and two muted yellow powder-feed indicator pixels below; keep the case completely industrial gray. Top is a gray recessed work panel with eight tiny muted-gold ingredient points around a small central dark square. Side is a plain gray service hatch and black horizontal vent with only two subtle gold indicator pixels. Active front changes just the sapling pixels to brighter green and powder indicators brighter yellow; no halo. This must look like a new original Mekanism factory block, not a wooden magic machine.
